task: Run 5 pricing conversations with SaaS finance leads to confirm $50-100/month willingness to pay
rationale: The single highest-leverage validation action — confirming pricing moves the UNCONFIRMED assumption to CONFIRMED, adding 0.12 to the weighted total and potentially shifting the verdict from PIVOT to GO

task: Interview 10 target customers about month-end close workflows to validate urgency trigger hypothesis
rationale: Urgency is the most surprising weakness given the confirmed pain level — if month-end close creates buying urgency, it changes the GTM strategy and improves the score by 0.08

task: Prototype a data aggregation layer to test whether reconciliation patterns create a defensibility advantage
rationale: Building the learning layer early while the customer base is small costs little but could create a durable moat if the pattern-matching improves with data volume
